about_short_description.short_description: Aptos is a Web3 startup that builds a scalable layer 1 blockchain.

product.name: Aptos Network
product.description: A scalable, open-source Layer 1 blockchain for executing smart contracts, recording transactions, and supporting decentralized applications and digital assets.

product.name: Geomi
product.description: A developer platform providing Aptos API access, on-chain data indexing, real-time transaction streaming, and infrastructure for building decentralized applications.

product.name: Petra Wallet
product.description: A self-custodial digital asset wallet for storing, managing, and transacting with tokens and digital collectibles on the Aptos blockchain.

product.name: Aptos Connect
product.description: A web-based wallet and authentication platform that lets applications provide Aptos account creation, login, and transaction signing through OAuth and social accounts.

product.name: Aptos Explorer
product.description: A blockchain explorer for viewing Aptos transactions, blocks, validators, network activity, and analytics in real time.

product.name: Aptos Names
product.description: A naming service that lets users register human-readable .apt blockchain names and associate them with Aptos wallet addresses.
